issues: Hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' IS STILL PRESENT on /admin/dashboard (contrary to review-request claim that iter54 fix removed it). Located in CustomOrdersList.jsx line 372 — the maker <select> dropdown. DOM inspection confirms each <option> contains a child <span data-ve-dynamic="true" x-excluded="true" x-line-number="372" ...> injected by the visual-editor dev tooling (x-* attributes are dev-only markers). Likely WON'T appear in production builds, but flags loudly in dev/preview console. 1 console error recorded per page render. Recommend verifying in prod build OR stripping the visual-editor wrapper for <option> children.

[good] Defense-in-depth except block also translates Stripe SDK 'may not have completed onboarding' errors to the same 409 shape, verified live against a test Stripe account that passes charges_enabled=true in Mongo but has not actually finished onboarding on Stripe's side.

[good] FinancialsTab.onDashboard correctly detects 409+detail.code='onboarding_incomplete' (and falls back to legacy string detection with regex) before silently re-launching stripeConnectOnboard. Same pattern in PayoutsTab — structurally reviewed, identical code path.

[good] CustomOrdersList ★ Route to top button: guarded by suggestions.length>0 && !order.assigned_maker_slug (only visible for unassigned briefs with suggestions), templated note 'Routed to you because: {reason}.', calls existing pushBriefToMaker + onChange refresh + toast. Click → push-to-maker → 200 verified live, brief transitioned to ASSIGNED state and BY MAKER funnel updated.
[good] data-testid='brief-autoroute-{order_id}' correctly namespaced; 74 distinct testids rendered for 74 unassigned briefs.
[minor · carry-over] Hydration warning '<span> in <option>' still present in preview — not introduced by iter55 but review-request claimed it was fixed. See design_issues above.

rca_of_the_issue: Hydration warning RCA: Options in the brief-maker-select dropdown are wrapped by the visual-editor dev tooling with <span data-ve-dynamic="true" x-excluded="true" x-file-name="CustomOrdersList" x-line-number="372">, which React flags as invalid HTML inside <option>. The x-* attributes indicate this is dev-only instrumentation; production builds may be clean. Reproduction: open /admin/dashboard in preview env with admin JWT, console logs 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>.' 1× per mount. Mitigation: either strip the visual-editor wrapper for children of <option>, or confirm the warning does not surface in the production build and close as dev-artifact.
